The Perceptual Quality Auditor missed this because it focuses on global noise/blur, not local semantic boundaries. The Topology Auditor's high confidence mask (0.93) confirms the sauce is a coherent blob, but doesn't rule out the merging artifact with the cake. I will maintain the severity ratings as they accurately reflect minor but noticeable generative softness.
